Read with openpyxl data_only (cached values) from 17 H2A v3.2018 case workbooks; each case = one process. Locator = workbook short name + sheet!cell (no page numbers). Loaded: design capacity, capacity factor, plant life, start-up year (year-available), capex as H2A Total Direct Capital Cost (installed) and Total Capital Costs (total-plant, also per kg/day design capacity), opex-fixed per year and levelized per kg, non-energy opex-variable per kg (derived), levelized cost, process efficiency (LHV), specific energy per carrier in GJ LHV/kg H2 from Results Energy Data (electricity used for CO2 sequestration added to electricity), net process CO2, CO2 captured and share-to-capture. Flows: native usage per kg H2 (mmBtu, kWh, kg, gallons) and water. Other-values: levelized cost breakdown, gross CO2, upstream GHG (GREET), carbon sequestration cost approximation. Dollar year: all workbooks set Reference year = 2015 and label results 'Year 2015 Real $/kg', so units are 2015_USD, although the user guide says the v3 default reference year is 2016 and price-table headers read $(2016). Traps: (1) current central coal CCS workbook has #NAME? cached errors in Total Capital Costs, fixed O&M, sequestration capital and the whole Results cost block - only direct capital (installed, incl. CO2 transport/storage/monitoring items) and non-cost values loaded; no LCOH. (2) current central biomass workbook has Carbon Sequestration switched on (90%) although its title and Capital Costs have no capture unit; its total capex, opex and LCOH include CO2 compression/pipeline/storage; future biomass case has it off. (3) future SOEC Title sheet still reads 'Solid Oxide Electrolysis Case (Current)'; start-up year 2040 and inputs differ, treated as future. (4) design capacity on the Input sheet differs from the Title sheet in coal (618,936 vs 616,500) and PEM cases; Input value used. (5) future central PEM Results has an extra 'Pressure Credit' row. (6) distributed NG Carbon Capture Efficiency cell is #REF! (no capture). (7) distributed cases price only the production skid (future cases include an H2 compressor item); forecourt CSD not included. Natural gas and CCS cases: H2A treats all feedstock carbon as process CO2 (no combustion/process split). Prices: AEO 2017 reference case.
